premises.text: Workers spend a large fraction of hours on email, and email dominates smartphone time
premises.evidence_span: You actually spend 28% of your working hours just dealing with your emails every day

premises.text: Smartphone email still looks like 1980s desktop email with subject lines, metadata, and signatures
premises.evidence_span: Subject lines, metadata, mailberry signatures. You can't really tell the difference

premises.text: Parsing engine turns inbox mail into a bubble conversation view with optional original view
premises.evidence_span: reformat all your emails into this conversation view so that you can mail like what you do, like text messaging. And you can always switch back to the original view by tapping the bubble

premises.text: @mentions assign tasks that appear in a tasks tab for the mentioned person
premises.evidence_span: mention someone with an at symbol to assign a task. For example, at Jason sent me the deck. And when Jason opens mail time, he will see this mail and also the tasks mentioned in this tab

premises.text: Participants can be added or removed like managing a group chat
premises.evidence_span: You can remove someone from the mail or add someone. As easy as what to do, like managing a group chat

premises.text: Length warnings push users to keep emails short enough to read
premises.evidence_span: Mailtime just told me that it's too long, didn't read. So I should probably get back and make it shorter

premises.text: No email content is stored in the cloud; cloud only triggers push on inbox changes
premises.evidence_span: we don't touch any content. with our cloud. So with our MilkTime Cloud, we just listen to what changes made in your inbox, and then send you a push notification
free to connect with first email account. We will charge you only $0.99 if you want to connect more email account
